command:
set -u
echo '=== REPOS ==='
for d in "$HOME/frankenstein-repo" "$HOME/frank-repo"; do
  if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then
    echo "REPO=$d"
    git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true
    git -C "$d" status --porcelain=v1 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
done
echo '=== OMEGA FILES ==='
for f in "$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts/voice_full_runtime.py" "$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts/voice_host_live_client.py" "$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts/frank_terminal.py" "$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts/omega_organ_activity.py" "$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts/voice_777_runtime.py" "$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts/voice_host_777_live_client.py" "$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts/frank_terminal_777.py"; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then sha256sum "$f"; else echo "MISSING $f"; fi
done
echo '=== USER SERVICES ==='
for u in frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service; do
  echo "UNIT=$u"
  systemctl --user show "$u" -p LoadState -p ActiveState -p SubState -p ExecStart -p DropInPaths --no-pager 2>&1 || true
done
echo '=== AVATAR READONLY ==='
systemctl --user show frankenstein-buehne.service -p LoadState -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID --no-pager 2>&1 || true
